caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile with a horizontal orientation, placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The textile design consists of an alternating pattern of vertical bands. The bands switch between warm brown and peach tones, and cooler grey and black hues, with a mix of subtle, muted colors such as reds, blues, and some hints of green and yellow interwoven within the stripes. Each band is composed of tightly packed zigzag and horizontal linear patterns, creating a layered, textured effect. The boundaries between color bands are defined by vertical grey and white grid-like sections, which act as separators. The textile’s edges are marked by short, perpendicular strokes in the corresponding band colors, suggesting a fringed finish on all sides. The entire composition is contained within a faint rectangular border lightly marked on the background.
title: Woven Rag Carpet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
